params.val: copies the same stat-stage increase onto the holder

custom condition type — on_stat_change as it exists is documented "(Self)"; this needs the opposite: reacting to an OPPONENT raising its own stat ADDED after re-verifying against Showdown data/abilities.ts (opportunist): the copy is NOT instant -- positive boosts a foe gains are accumulated (onFoeAfterBoost), then actually applied to the holder later, at a low-priority onAnySwitchIn/onAnyAfterMega point (effectively at the next such window, not the same instant the foe's stat rose). Boosts caused by Opportunist or Mirror Herb themselves are excluded from being re-copied, to avoid infinite chains between multiple Opportunist/Mirror Herb holders.
